_:
repo ~/i/ed is gold hogan's portfolio, live at ed.apexlinks.org. stack: sveltekit (next), svelte 5 runes, tailwind 4, cloudflare workers adapter, pnpm, node 24.
goal: fix every point of the 2026-10-07 copy critique.
copy: every user-facing string comes verbatim from plan/copy-deck.md, in the section the step names. never write your own copy.
settled with ed, do not revisit:
- the name is gold hogan. the footer's "© … gold edem hogan" stays: it bridges the 20 cold emails signed ed hogan.
- the page splits by country on data.g. true = nigeria: naira, whatsapp first, flyers and logos first. false = everyone else: usd, email first, the $360 homepage from ed's cold emails first.
- usd prices go back to pre-cut. the homepage is $360 / ₦90,000 flat.
- staging, bluehour, hated and mca leave the wall. every piece that used ai says so in its line.
files: src/lib/design.ts (work, kinds, prices, site_price, money), src/routes/+page.svelte (page copy, start form, sites list), src/routes/+page.server.ts (data.g), src/routes/+layout.svelte (head), src/lib/components/Lightbox.svelte, src/lib/data.ts (p = contact info, read only).
code rules: copy all lowercase, no emoji, ’ for apostrophes. snake_case. single-letter keys get a comment at their definition. no new comments except a non-obvious why. no single-use variables.
traps: pnpm check type-checks build output, and its wrangler types --check needs that output, so gates run svelte-check on a clean tree, then build. pnpm lint (prettier, eslint) was red before this plan: never reformat a file or fix unrelated lint. a dev server may already run: check `ss -ltnp | grep 9270` and tail .log, reuse it, start one only if none runs. from preview_override on, /?c=ng and /?c=us show each country.
after each mark: commit only that step's files plus plan/copy.plan.json, plan/copy.log and plan/copy.notes.md if present (.log, .dev-logs/ and static/macro/ are unrelated: never stage them). conventional commit with scope copy (e.g. `fix(copy): restore usd prices`), a body of - bullets, trailers last. then git push: push deploys to production.

usd_prices.s:
visitors outside nigeria see the pre-cut usd prices and the $360 homepage price from ed's cold emails.
1. in src/lib/design.ts `prices`, set only the `u` values: flyer or poster 25, social media pack 40, logo 49, brand kit 120, label or packaging 60, t-shirt or merch 30. leave every `n` (naira) as it is.
2. set `site_price` to { u: 360, n: 90000 }.
3. nothing else: the `d` lines change in price_lines, the websites wording in section_headings.
why: on 2026-10-06, 20 us businesses got an email offering a homepage for $360 flat with a link here, and the page says websites start from $63.
usd_prices.t: grep -qF "{ t: 'flyer or poster', u: 25, n: 9000" src/lib/design.ts && grep -qF 'u: 40, n: 13500' src/lib/design.ts && grep -qF 'u: 49, n: 18000' src/lib/design.ts && grep -qF 'u: 120, n: 36000' src/lib/design.ts && grep -qF 'u: 60, n: 18000' src/lib/design.ts && grep -qF 'u: 30, n: 9000' src/lib/design.ts && grep -qF 'site_price = { u: 360, n: 90000 }' src/lib/design.ts && rm -rf .svelte-kit/output .svelte-kit/cloudflare .svelte-kit/cloudflare-tmp && pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --threshold error && pnpm build

preview_override.s:
anyone can preview either country: /?c=ng shows the nigerian page, and /?c=us (any other code) shows everyone else's.
1. in src/routes/+page.server.ts, `g` reads the `c` query param first (case-insensitive), then platform.cf.country, then the cf-ipcountry header, as it does now.
2. extend the `g` comment to say that ?c= overrides it.
why: ed works from nigeria and cannot otherwise see what his us leads see, and later steps check both versions this way.
look: `curl -s 'http://localhost:9270/?c=us'` shows `$`, and `?c=ng` shows `₦`.
preview_override.t: grep -qE "searchParams\.get\(['\"]c['\"]\)" src/routes/+page.server.ts && grep -qF '?c=' src/routes/+page.server.ts && rm -rf .svelte-kit/output .svelte-kit/cloudflare .svelte-kit/cloudflare-tmp && pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --threshold error && pnpm build

drop_pieces.s:
four pieces leave the wall: staging, bluehour and hated (ai made most of each, and illustration is not for sale) and mca (it reads as a maga joke).
1. remove the `work` entries with s 'staging', 'bluehour', 'hated' and 'mca' from src/lib/design.ts.
2. remove the 'illustration' entry from `kinds`, since no piece uses it after this.
3. `git rm` their files: static/work/staging-0, -1, -2, -t, bluehour-0, -1, -t, hated-0, -t and mca-0, -t (all .webp).
4. keep tmg: its pictures are hand vector.
the counts derive from `work`, so 27 shows up everywhere by itself.

og_image.s:
a 1200x630 share image shows three real designs.
1. write static/og.jpg: background #0b0a08, with three 360x360 tiles centre-cropped from static/work/udens-t.webp, oktai-t.webp and bioburger-t.webp, left to right. 30px gaps, 30px side margins, centred vertically. no text.
2. make it with system python3 and PIL (already installed) as a one-off script in your scratch dir. the script never enters the repo.
3. jpeg at about quality 85, under 300 kB, because whatsapp drops bigger preview images.
open the jpg and look at it before marking.
og_image.t: python3 -I -c "import os; from PIL import Image; im = Image.open('static/og.jpg'); assert im.size == (1200, 630) and im.format == 'JPEG' and os.path.getsize('static/og.jpg') < 300000" && rm -rf .svelte-kit/output .svelte-kit/cloudflare .svelte-kit/cloudflare-tmp && pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --threshold error && pnpm build

outreach_signature.s:
future cold emails and drafts are signed gold hogan, like the site.
1. in $HOME/.client-hunt/.env, change only the FROM_NAME line to `FROM_NAME=Gold Hogan`, with sed. never print that file: it holds the gmail app password.
2. in $HOME/.agents/skills/client-hunt/send.py, both 'Ed Hogan' defaults become 'Gold Hogan'.
3. in $HOME/.agents/skills/client-hunt/SKILL.md, `FROM_NAME=Ed Hogan` becomes `FROM_NAME=Gold Hogan`.
4. in $HOME/.agents/skills/client-hunt/render.py, the draft note's name comes from the env FROM_NAME the way send.py reads it, with default 'Gold Hogan'.
5. never re-render or redeploy the existing drafts in ~/i/dump: the 20 sent emails say ed hogan.
commit in ~/.agents only these three files (that repo has unrelated changes), then push.
outreach_signature.t: grep -qx 'FROM_NAME=Gold Hogan' $HOME/.client-hunt/.env && ! grep -qF 'Ed Hogan' $HOME/.agents/skills/client-hunt/send.py $HOME/.agents/skills/client-hunt/SKILL.md $HOME/.agents/skills/client-hunt/render.py && grep -qF 'FROM_NAME' $HOME/.agents/skills/client-hunt/render.py && python3 -I -c "import ast, sys; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in sys.argv[1:]]" $HOME/.agents/skills/client-hunt/send.py $HOME/.agents/skills/client-hunt/render.py

live_check.s:
production serves the new copy to both countries.
1. make sure every earlier commit is pushed. the push starts a cloudflare workers build, and the gate polls the live site for up to 10 minutes.
2. the gate resolves through dns-over-https, because this laptop's dns can fake an outage.
3. if the gate times out, the build failed or stalled. use the stuck skill, fix it, push, and mark again.
then look at https://ed.apexlinks.org/?c=us and /?c=ng in agent-browser (ab-1440fl) at phone and desktop widths, and open /og.jpg.
live_check.t: for i in $(seq 1 30); do u=$(curl -s --doh-url https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query 'https://ed.apexlinks.org/?c=us'); n=$(curl -s --doh-url https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query 'https://ed.apexlinks.org/?c=ng'); if printf '%s' "$u" | grep -qF 'your new homepage, live' && printf '%s' "$u" | grep -qF '$360 flat' && printf '%s' "$n" | grep -qF 'see your flyer' && printf '%s' "$n" | grep -qF 'flyers from ₦9,000' && printf '%s' "$n" | grep -qF 'og.jpg' && curl -sf --doh-url https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query -o /dev/null https://ed.apexlinks.org/og.jpg; then exit 0; fi; sleep 20; done; exit 1
